verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a government online filing portal can publish its maintenance windows, daily limits, and session timeouts. None of the evidence documents any of these. The only related line is the marketing phrase "anytime, anywhere" for Online Services, which is a general availability claim, not a published disclosure of hours, per-day limits, or session-timeout rules shown before a user starts. The /e-services/ account pages were not fetched (robots-disallowed), so any notices there are unevidenced.
